summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Home Shred at 420x900 mobile viewport. Today happens to be Wednesday (rest day) so Today screen showed the REST DAY / Recovery Mode view with 5 stretches (correct). All 4 tabs, Week strip (Mon-Sun with Mon showing PUSH + SHORT BREAK divider + Push-Ups; Wed/Sun showing Rest; Fri showing Jump Rope), History (streak/week/total tiles, 7-dot week-tracker, reps-chart), Settings (dark toggle, rest default 60s -> 75s via +15, reset flow with confirm & cancel), and page reload persistence all work. Rest timer overlay opens/closes and +/-15s and pause toggle all responsive. Training-day per-set logging UI (checkmark fill, band L/M/H selector, cardio Mark Done, Skip toggle, inline rest button between blocks) could NOT be exercised end-to-end because today is a rest day; those data-testids are only rendered on the Today screen for training days. Recommend re-running full test on a training day (Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri/Sat).
passed: today-rest visible on Wednesday with Recovery Mode + 5 stretches
rest-timer overlay opens from Today, remaining=1:00, +/-15s and toggle & close all work
Week strip: 7 days (week-day-mon..sun) clickable; Mon shows PUSH/SHORT BREAK/Push-Ups; Wed & Sun show Rest; Fri shows Jump Rope
History: stat-streak, stat-week, stat-total, week-tracker with 7 week-dot-*, reps-chart present
Reset flow: reset-data-button -> reset-confirm -> reset-cancel works; confirm-yes clears state and shows 'All workout data cleared' toast
Page reload preserves localStorage state (persistence verified)
